components.text:
The Sound of the Cleansing Soul (internally: Upgrade Remove Ritual) strips an upgrade or downgrade from your worn Living Armour while you stand on the Master Ritual Stone, refunding some of the points spent on it - the counterpart to Penance of the Leaden Soul. Tier 0, costs $(blood)25,000 LP$() to activate.
Use a Ritual Diviner [Dusk] for easier construction.
